question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The correct answer is "folded."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "folded" means to bend one part of something over another part in order to make it smaller, tidier, etc. (किसी वस्‍तु के एक भाग को मोड़कर दूसरे पर जमाना (उसे छोटा करने, सँभालने आदि के लिए); तह लगाना, तहाना, मोड़ना)

 
 
• Example: *He **folded**__ the letter into three before putting it into the envelope.*
 
 
 
• The paragraph conveys that standing on the grass with her arms rolled up the other mother was waiting for her.
 
• The correct answer is Option 4.
 
• Correct paragraph:

Outside, the world had become a formless, __amorphous__ with no shape, while the house itself seemed to have twisted and stretched. There was sticky web-stuff __clung__ to her arm, and she wiped it off as best as she could. The other mother was waiting for her, standing on the grass with her arms __**folded**__. Her black button eyes were expressionless, but her lips were pressed tightly in a cold ______ (4) ______. When she saw Myna she reached ______ (5) _______ one long white hand, and she crooked a finger.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

 
• Joined: **to fasten or connect one thing to another. (एक वस्‍तु से दूसरी वस्‍तु को बाँधना या जोड़ना)
 
• **Entwined: **wind or twist together; interweave. (एक साथ हवा या मोड़; गूंथना)
 
• **Entangled: **cause to become twisted together with or caught in. (एक साथ मुड़ जाने या फँस जाने का कारण)
